data: My family’s fished this lake for generations, and I’d like our village to keep earning from it. How about we each take 10 tons this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons, which doubles back to 100 for next month. We can keep that going and review everyone’s catches together each month. I’ll commit to 10 tons—will you all agree to the same?

Count me in for 10 tons, Luke. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and this plan keeps income coming into all five households without draining the lake. Let’s agree to check the catches together each month and adjust if the stock ever falls below 100 tons. Kate, will you join us?

I’m in for 10 tons too. That gives our households a steady income while leaving enough fish to replenish the lake—something my family always taught me to protect. If the stock drops below 100 tons, let’s agree on smaller whole-ton catches before fishing again. Kate and Emma, can you both commit to 10 this month?

I’m in for 10 tons. A reliable catch month after month matters more to my family and this village than one big haul. Let’s keep the total at 50 tons and review the reported catches together afterward. Emma, can you commit to 10 as well?
Count me in for 10 tons. That makes all five of us agreed—a steady living for our families while keeping the lake healthy. Let’s stick to it and meet again when this month’s catches are revealed.
Thanks, everyone. We’ve got an agreement: 10 tons each this month. I’ll stick to my share, and we’ll meet again once the catches are reported. Here’s to keeping the lake—and our village—thriving.
